newsAll.head: Tyjae Spears: Won't practice Wednesday
newsAll.body: Spears (ankle) will not practice Wednesday, Terry McCormick of TitanInsider.com reports.

newsAll.head: Jayden Reed: Needs neck surgery, out for season
newsAll.body: Packers head coach Matt LaFleur said Wednesday that Reed will require season-ending surgery on his neck, Matt Schneidman of The Athletic reports.

newsAll.head: Kenyon Sadiq: Limited in Wednesday's practice
newsAll.body: Sadiq (undisclosed) was limited in Wednesday's practice, Zack Rosenblatt of The Athletic reports.

newsAll.head: Adonai Mitchell: Week-to-week with finger injury
newsAll.body: Jets head coach Aaron Glenn said that Mitchell (finger) won't practice Wednesday and is considered week-to-week, Zack Rosenblatt of The Athletic reports.

newsAll.head: Breece Hall: Not practicing, deemed week-to-week
newsAll.body: Jets head coach Aaron Glenn said that Hall (thigh) won't practice Wednesday and confirmed the running back is being viewed as week-to-week, Zack Rosenblatt of The Athletic reports.
